module_summary: Traffic light controller: 2-bit state FSM advances when a down-counting timer hits 3; decoded lamps pass through two register stages and their rising edges reload the timer.

anchors.name: lamp
anchors.why: Light state register: boot, stop, go, slow; decoded into lamp outputs.

anchors.name: tmr
anchors.why: Down-counting phase timer reloaded per light; value 3 advances FSM.

anchors.name: red
anchors.why: Red lamp output, delayed decode of STOP state.

anchors.name: yellow
anchors.why: Yellow lamp output, delayed decode of SLOW state.

anchors.name: green
anchors.why: Green lamp output, delayed decode of GO; enables pedestrian cut.

anchors.name: pass_request
anchors.why: Pedestrian request shortening a long green by reloading timer.

anchors.name: hg
anchors.why: First-stage decoded lamp register (representative of hr/hy/hg) feeding outputs.

anchors.name: fresh_g
anchors.why: Green onset edge reloading timer with 60 (representative of fresh_y/fresh_r).

anchors.name: cut_short
anchors.why: Request during long green; reloads timer to 10.

groups.name: light_fsm
groups.description: Boot/stop/go/slow state machine advancing on timer hit.

groups.name: phase_timer
groups.description: Down counter reloaded on lamp onset or pedestrian cut; exported as clock.

groups.name: lamp_outputs
groups.description: Two register stages of decoded lamp state driving red/yellow/green.
